_read_me: Every price and every 'what's included' line on the site comes from this file. Change a line here, run `npm run prices`, commit. Anything with "confirmed": false is a draft: it shows with a dotted amber underline, and `npm run release-check` (the release gate in CI) fails until it is set to true.

items: Custom design and build, not a template
Domain set up, or moved from your old provider with old links redirected
Domain and email records looked after
Contact form to your email or printer
Changes when you ask: photos, prices, hours
Your domain and your photos stay yours.
No promises to be #1 on Google.
